python.title: Python in Kannada
python.description: Learn Python from scratch to production-grade code - in Kannada.
python.author: shyamiscoding
python.subtitle: PIZZA BY THE CODE
python.target: BCA/MCA/Engg Students, Freshers, and developers targeting 1% capability
welcomeParagraphs: This is the complete, premium study companion for the popular YouTube series Python in Kannada by shyamiscoding. Every single part is compiled with deep conceptual notes, copyable code blocks, and the exact lesson video - all in one unified, high-contrast dashboard.

Our core objective: teach Python from fundamental memory models up to professional production code. We focus on teaching you to think like a robust engineer, rather than just memorize syntax to pass exams.

cloud.tagline: CLOUD COMPUTING - BY PRUTHVI RAJ B
cloud.author: PRUTHVI RAJ B
cloud.subtitle: UNDER THE HOOD PLUMBING
cloud.target: SysAdmins, DevOps Engineers, and developers targeting cloud mastery
cloud.goal: Master virtualization, container orchestration, and elastic infrastructures
welcomeParagraphs: This is the companion learning dashboard for the **Cloud Computing** course by **shyamiscoding**.
Master the engineering principles of virtual machines, hypervisors, VPC networks, serverless paradigms, and container orchestration.
We dive beneath cloud control panels to understand how the plumbing actually operates. You will learn to orchestrate reliable, elastic, and secure infrastructures.
